# NSPanel HAUI 0.4.7

A consolidation release with no firmware or display changes. It collapses CI
into one pipeline, makes development builds a deliberate action instead of a
side effect of every push, lays the data foundation for the v0.5 frontend
rework, and improves the editor preview's idle control.

## Before updating

Nothing changes for existing panels: the release ships no firmware or display
changes, so no firmware or TFT install follows. Update the integration through
the Marketplace as usual. There are no breaking changes and no migration steps.

## Changed

- **One CI pipeline** — `ci.yml` runs every push/PR gate (tests, frontend,
  ESPHome config, docs, hassfest, HACS) and deploys Pages from a docs build
  made once per run. Development firmware builds commit the version and the
  regenerated screen overview as a single `[skip ci]` bot commit;
  `screens_only` regenerates the screens without a build.
- **Development builds are dispatched manually** — a push to `dev` no longer
  publishes a prerelease, pushes a bot version commit or regenerates the
  screens. Dispatch **Development Firmware** when the build changes what a
  device installs (firmware or display inputs); hub-only, docs and frontend
  changes ride along in the next build. The PEP 440 tag rules are unchanged, so
  Marketplace ordering stays correct.
- **Frontend data foundation** — the editor now runs on one observable store
  (`frontend/store/`) and one typed API client (`frontend/api/client.js`)
  behind the existing views. `docs/frontend.md` records the module boundaries,
  migration rules and the v0.5 information architecture, and
  `design/dashboard-prototype.html` is the visual target for the rework. There
  is no visible change.
- **The preview's idle control toggles** — the zzz button opens the idle page
  and, pressed again while the idle page is shown, wakes back to the panel it
  covered (or the home panel) and restarts the interaction timer. It behaves
  the same in Simulated and Live mode
  ([Configuration](docs/configuration/README.md#the-live-preview)).

## Fixed

- Opening the Simulated preview starts the virtual panel over on its home panel
  with the real Home Assistant entity states, as switching back from Live
  already did.
